title: Name the existing pinned pullback composition family
statement: Name, without a new choice, the exact family of derived pullback composition isomorphisms already appearing in the canonical base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. It is the fourth chosen witness of exists_derivedPullbackComposition [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] for the supplied family of derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. For f:X→Y and g:Y→Z it compares Lg* followed by Lf* with L(f≫g)* [def-pc-derived-pullback].
